# The World of Telrhin

> Telrhin is a homebrew sword & sorcery tabletop RPG campaign setting in continuous development since 1981. It's a late-medieval, magic-and-dragons fantasy world built on a dark cosmology: two entwined creator gods, a dying "Great Dream" drifting toward an apocalyptic "Edge of Waking," and gods who secretly feed on mortal death to survive. This site is the personal home base for the setting and its campaigns — not a commercial product.

The site documents 40+ years of a home-grown campaign world (city-state of Larakan, the Boradun burrowdelfs, the fallen Destinite Empire, and more), the house rules used to run it (Stabmaster, Fat Dragon, "Stabdragon," and Dragonbane with homebrew additions), and the campaigns currently in play (Endorian Bay in Dragonbane, Hill East in D&D 5E). Most deep-reference material — the full Field Guide, the Encyclopaedia Telrhinica campaign database, complete campaign logs, and the full site menu — is gated to players and friends. The blog contains public lore excerpts, world-design essays, and campaign history. Author: Christian Aldridge.

## Start Here

- [Homepage](https://www.telrhin.com/): Setting overview — the cosmology, current campaigns, house rules, and what's publicly available on the site.
- [About](https://www.telrhin.com/about): About the site, its author, and the friends who contributed to the setting; notes on what's public vs. gated to players.
- [Blog index](https://www.telrhin.com/blog): Full chronological list of lore, design, and campaign posts.

## World & Cosmology

- [Serpent Earth](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/serpent-earth): The founding myth of Serpent Earth and the world's drift toward the "Edge of Waking."
- [Three Worlds](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/three-worlds): The cosmology of the Three Worlds (Prime, the Umbra, and the Ember/Oneiros).
- [The World Story](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/world-story): Broad strokes of the Serpent Earth monomyth underlying the setting.
- [The World: A Bedtime Story](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/world-bedtime-story): An origin tale for how Telrhin came to be.
- [The Central Story](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/the-central-story): The core narrative thread tying the setting together.
- [Origins](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/origins): On the origins of the Telrhin setting.
- [Revisiting the Origin Story](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/revisiting-the-origin-story): Later musings on the setting's origin tale and world design.
- [Philosophy in a World of Gods and Magic](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/philosophy-in-a-world-of-gods-and-magic): How philosophy and belief function inside a world with literal gods and magic.
- [The Gods Want You to Die](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/the-gods-want-you-to-die): On the true, parasitic nature of Telrhin's gods.
- [Lost Gods](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/lost-gods): The lost or forgotten gods of the setting.
- [Tala the Wise](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/tala-the-wise): The figure of Tala the Wise.
- [Divine Empress](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/divine-empress): The Divine Empress and her role in the setting.
- [Severed Queen](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/severed-queen): Talon, the Severed Queen, who seeks to unmake reality.
- [Court of Kalidahr](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/court-of-kalidahr): The Court of Kalidahr Irongrip — faie courts and politics.
- [Valek Social Factions](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/valek-social-factions): Social factions in Valek.
- [Normal Folks in a World of Monsters](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/normal-folks-in-a-world-of-monsters): How ordinary people live and cope in a world full of monsters.
- [The Pox Crain](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/the-pox-crain): The Pox Crain — a place where things are more than they seem.
- [God Meat / Sylas Cult](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/god-meat-sylas-cult): The cult of Sylas and the concept of "god meat."
- [Rakshem](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/rakshem): The setting element of Rakshem.
- [Eloche](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/eloche): Eloche, the First City, torn from the earth by the gods.
- [Sky Above](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/sky-above): The sky and heavens of Telrhin.
- [The Ninth City](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/the-ninth-city): The Ninth City.
- [Valley of Drowned Kings](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/valley-drowned-kings): The Valley of Drowned Kings.
- [City of Pearl](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/city-of-pearl): The City of Pearl.
- [Quartz Sea](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/quartz-sea): The Quartz Sea.
- [Paths of the Chimerum](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/paths-of-the-chimerum): The Chimerum and its paths.
- [Kobolds](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/kobolds): Kobolds as they appear in the Telrhin setting.
- [De-Elfing the Fantasy World](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/de-elfing-the-fantasy-world): Design notes on reworking classic fantasy races (elves, dwarves, etc.) for the setting.
- [Indago](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/indago): On the spirit of exploration and investigation ("indago") behind the setting.
- [What's Fashion if not a Codpiece](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/whats-fashion-if-not-a-codpiece): On panache, style, and fashion within the game world.
- [Ravines and Other Killers](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/ravines-and-other-killers): Wilderness hazards and campaign mishaps.
